notes.title: The Story of the Watchtower
notes.content:
The Story of the Watchtower 🏕️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862659/243339d5e0fb9fe3a1a38e6e177e59082633fac3.png

Hello photographers! 👋

Today, we take you deep into the Alaskan wilderness, where an old fire watchtower stands tall among the endless forests. Once a crucial lookout point for spotting wildfires, it now serves as a remote home for a park caretaker. This unique location carries a rich history, blending the solitude of the past with the personal struggles of the present.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862659/034bab131f83e4209dba02624de88251160de390.jpg
A Glimpse Into the Past 🔥

Fire watchtowers like this one were once scattered across vast wilderness areas, including Alaska. Rangers stationed in these towers spent long hours scanning the horizon for the first signs of smoke, using tools like the Osborne Fire Finder—an essential device still standing at the heart of our watchtower. Their work was critical in protecting the forests and wildlife from devastating fires.

But with modern satellite systems and aerial surveillance, many of these towers were abandoned. Some were left to decay, while others, like the one in Photography Simulator, found new purposes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862659/baba0e0dc3d9e1702005a27fe5fac038f822d06f.jpg
A New Life in the Tower 🏡

In our game, the watchtower is no longer a lookout for fires but a home for a park caretaker. He spends his days maintaining the surrounding area, documenting wildlife, and keeping the tower in good shape. To make the space feel more personal, he decorates it with drawings sent by his child—a small but touching detail that brings warmth to the otherwise isolated structure.

However, living in the tower is not without its challenges. The caretaker has a fear of heights, making every climb up the tower an uneasy battle. The spiral staircase creaks under his steps, and the open-air platform at the top tests his nerves. Yet, duty calls, and he must face his fears to keep the park safe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862659/636e9e5db7404a934ff81db4dd04e24ef6559040.jpg
How the Watchtower Connects to Photography Simulator 📷

In Photography Simulator, the world is full of stories waiting to be discovered, and the watchtower is one of them. As you explore the park, you’ll come across this towering structure, offering breathtaking views of the Alaskan wilderness. The elevated vantage point is perfect for spotting wildlife, capturing dramatic shots of sunrises and storms, and immersing yourself in the quiet beauty of nature.

Inside, you’ll find the caretaker’s modest living space, scattered with personal items, old logbooks, and even his child’s drawings. These small details bring the place to life, telling a silent but powerful story about the people who dedicate their lives to preserving nature.

Would you dare to climb to the top for the perfect shot? 📸
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862659/cb81aaa4dd5ae0f9c6e3e87b375b86ccafcc6dcd.jpg

Did You Know? 🤔

🔥 The Osborne Fire Finder, still inside the tower, was used by rangers for decades to pinpoint fire locations with impressive accuracy.
🌲 Some fire towers are still operational today, with volunteers spending days or even weeks in complete solitude, watching for smoke.
📷 Photographers often visit old fire towers for their unique, panoramic views—just like you can in Photography Simulator!

What do you think of this location? Would you stay in a watchtower like this? Let us know in the comments! 👇

notes.title: Elk Through the Lens
notes.content:
Hello photographers!👋

Today, we take you to the heart of Alaska majestic landscapes to encounter one of the most iconic wildlife inhabitants - the elk, also known as the Canadian deer. We wanted to capture not only the grandeur and dignity of this animal but also the unique challenges involved in observing and photographing it.

[previewyoutube=P6t9XAd1tPI;full][/previewyoutube]

Realism in Every Move🦌

While working on the elk model, we focused on two key aspects: its impressive appearance and authentic behavior. Our teams of artists and developers analyzed countless hours of footage to recreate every detail - from its sprawling antlers to the subtle movements of its ears reacting to sounds in the surroundings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41191950/27aa45b7aac95f1dcec1b42e50f78f729ea583aa.png
Additionally, the elk’s AI system was designed to realistically respond to its environment. A sudden noise? You'll see the animal freeze, assess the threat, and then flee with surprising agility. Stay quiet, and you might capture the elk in a peaceful moment, such as grazing or bugling during the rutting season.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41191950/3b69c2e92c1b08158f6d43138669cb1a02b0d876.png
Fun Facts About Elk

Did you know that elk are one of the largest members of the deer family, second only to moose? Male elk, or bulls, can boast antlers with a span of up to 1.2 meters (4 feet)! These antlers are shed and regrown every year, with growth rates reaching up to 2.5 cm per day.

Another fascinating fact is their communication. Elk are famous for their distinctive bugle calls, which can carry for miles. These loud sounds serve to establish dominance and attract females. Capturing this behavior in the game presents a truly unique challenge!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41191950/224adb261a5640cb42add9181ca3fbb998fda930.png
Do you dream of capturing a herd grazing in the morning mist, or perhaps a dynamic shot of two bulls locking antlers? Share your ideas and experiences in the comments - your feedback is always an inspiration for us!

notes.title: Totems Glade: History and Secrets🌲📸
notes.content:
Hello, photographers! 👋
We’ve got some exciting news about a new location in Photography Simulator: The Totem Glade. Get your lenses ready because this spot holds not only beauty but also mystery.

🌿 What is this place?
The Totem Glade is a hidden area deep in the forest where nature meets ancient beliefs. You'll find hand-carved totems, each with unique symbolism, surrounded by lush greenery, morning mist, and sunlight filtering through dense treetops. This location challenges not just your skills but also your attention to detail.
[previewyoutube=2cia60em03w;full][/previewyoutube]
🏞️ Unique Photography Challenges:
Changing light: On the glade, sunlight creates breathtaking contrasts and shadow play, shifting throughout the day. Capturing the perfect shot will test your abilities!

Hidden details: Every totem tells a different story. Discover the symbols and textures that reveal their ancient meanings

Life on the glade: Roaming animals, birds in flight, or morning fog – capturing these dynamic elements will thrill every nature photography enthusiast

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41191950/3434b604abe00dab77fe977c059b9d6d5f0abf0f.gif

🔍 Secrets for Explorers:
The Totem Glade isn’t just a place for photos; it’s also a space filled with mysteries:

Hidden runes: can be found here, offering clues to the larger story of the game world.

Some totems react to your presence – pay close attention to changes in the environment as you approach with your camera.

Can you capture the so-called "Spirit of the Glade"? It’s said that only the most patient photographers can spot it... 👻📷

notes.title: Bison's Daily Routine
notes.content:
Attention Photographers!

Step into the world of bison! Experience their daily routines, from grazing to resting, and capture stunning photos with every unique interaction 📸
[previewyoutube=brZNWOcxfVQ;full][/previewyoutube]

💡Fun Fact About Bison: Did you know that bison can sprint at speeds of up to 35 miles per hour,😱 despite their massive size? Imagine this: a herd of bison charging across the plains, powerful and unstoppable. In Photography Simulator, this could make for an exciting encounter or a high-stakes challenge, especially if you find yourself having to outrun or strategically navigate around them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41191950/4e24b5e7a77230461ccf351068d77937af6c2267.gif

A Bison's Daily Routine: Bison spend most of their day searching for food and resting.🌿 They are herbivores and travel considerable distances each day to find grass and herbs. Their day is mainly divided into three stages: grazing, resting, and moving. During rest periods, they often chew cud to aid digestion. They are more active during the cooler hours of the morning and evening, while in the middle of the day, when temperatures rise, they rest in the shade. Bison live in groups, which helps protect them from predators and assists in raising their young. ❗️Isrupting their routine might cause them to react defensively, or perhaps you could use their predictable habits to your advantage!❗️

Are you ready to come face to face with a bison and take exciting photos of it? Let's check it out!
